_notes: Vanilla eyeblossom, potted eyeblossom, dried ghast and nether portal routines, recorded by the asset generator's EyeblossomGhastPortalFixtures.java against a block view of the case's setup (air elsewhere, void air outside the build height of -64 to 319), with a legacy random seeded with seed (0 by default) as both the routine's random and the level's. call is randomTick (the origin's state, only when its isRandomlyTicking holds, which ticks records), tick (the origin's scheduled tick) or set (Level.setBlock of state at the origin with UPDATE_ALL). dimension (minecraft:overworld by default) gives the dimension type's attributes and its timelines, sampled with every clock at dayTime (0 by default); biomes add nothing. difficulty (normal by default), spawnMobs and spawnMonsters (true by default) are the level's; playerNear (true by default) answers anyPlayerCloseEnoughForSpawning. The level's game time is 20, chunks have no inhabited time, and getCurrentDifficultyAt is the DifficultyInstance of the difficulty at that game time. Writes store the block and, as Level.setBlock does, run the new state's onPlace and then, unless UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE is set, the neighbours' shape updates; neighbour notifications are not run. draws lists each draw in order; writes the block changes with their flags; scheduled the block and fluid ticks scheduled with their delays (a block tick counts as pending for hasScheduledTick, as do the case's pending ticks); events the level events; gameEvents the game events with the state they carry; sounds every sound with its position (or the entity it follows), source, volume and pitch (null when the pitch comes from a mob's own random, as a mob's ambient sound's does); particles the particles sent; entities the entities added, with their rotation, age, portal cooldown, main hand and spawn flags; destroyed the blocks destroyed and whether they drop. after holds the final state of every setup or written position. The neighbour scan an eyeblossom makes reads the view through chunk sections, so it visits blocks in vanilla's section order.
